_provenance: Global run periods of Vortex events for the historic replay (history_runs.event_runs). Starts: event_archive.json release plus event_history.json runs (and added events). Ends: the 'Event Period' (PST, last day inclusive) on the event's Brave Exvius wiki page (exvius.fandom.com; saved pages in ios-server/research/wiki, others fetched live and read 2026-11-12), matched to a start when the period starts within 4 days of it or contains it; claim/summon/exchange periods are ignored. A run keeps its schedule start; its end is the wiki's. Periods on an event's own page that no start matched are added as runs (reruns the schedule missed). Runs with no period get default_days: the median length of the matched runs of their kind group (story, exchange, raid, exploration, challenge, daily, equipment, other; 'all' for the rest), source 'default N days'. Undated areas dated from their parent event page are in newly_dated. bad_starts: archive/schedule starts that are a one-year typo of the wiki period (the consumer should ignore them). Built by ios-server/devtools/build_event_runs.py; report in ios-server/research/EVENT_RUNS.md.
